7. Complete Payment Flow — End to End
From customer visit to money in user's bank account
Admin marks paid via admin dashboard
• One pending request at a time
• Minimum Cashout: $50 USD — users cannot request cashout below this threshold
• One Request at a Time: Users cannot submit a new cashout while one is pending/processing
• Bank Info Required: Users must save bank information before requesting cashout
• Rejection: When admin rejects a payout, earnings stay APPROVED — user can request again
• Completion: When admin completes a payout, all associated earnings are marked as PAID atomically
• Void Payments: Business charge payments can be voided — automatically recalculates charge status
